# Vendored Browser Assets

These files are committed so the control-app field kit works without CDN
access.

- `maplibre-gl/`: MapLibre GL JS `5.24.0`, BSD-3-Clause
- `pmtiles/`: PMTiles browser runtime `4.4.1`, BSD-3-Clause

The large Kyiv PMTiles map bundle is not committed. Generate or download it to
`control-app/kyiv-oblast.pmtiles` for field use.
